answer: Comet-linked collateral lockout. Each new identity must post a small deposit, but the deposit is locked to the operator's shared collateral pool, not the wallet. If any identity from that pool is flagged for sybil behavior, the entire pool is frozen and slashed proportionally. This means an attacker running many wallets pays the full pool cost per flagged identity. The sable audit trail records pool membership on-chain, so operators cannot hide behind fresh wallets. A basalt-hard cap on pool size forces attackers to spread across many pools,
